what: Hit FX drawn over a monster when a hero's hit lands. Floor 1 teaches: the slime resists blades (axe, dagger), Ilsevar's frost wand is its counter.

whenToUse.resist: combat resistMul(...) < 1 (resist_blades monster hit by blade/pierce: axe, dagger). Play resist_goo INSTEAD of the monster's pale 'hurt' flash frame; keep the HP loss and the sfx. That's what makes it read weaker than a normal hit.
whenToUse.weak: combat resistMul(...) > 1 (frost: wand, scroll). Play the normal 'hurt' frame AND weak_frost on top.
whenToUse.normal: resistMul == 1: unchanged (hurt frame only, no hit FX).

resist_goo.blend: normal (alpha 0/255, palette64 colours). Never additive: it has to read dull.

pivotInImage.note: the ripple centre (the dent) sits at 62% down the image; droplets rise above it

weak_frost.blend: ADDITIVE (THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite false, unlit / MeshBasic or SpriteMaterial with fog false, toneMapped false, alphaTest 0). Alpha carries the falloff (60..255); with normal blending it still reads, just flatter.

scales: near / mid / far use the same 80:50:30 ratio as the monster billboards. Pick the scale the monster sprite is using. proto3d currently only loads *_near monster frames and lets three.js shrink them: then use the _near FX too.
worldSize: same texel density as the monster: fxWorldW = monster.baseW * fxImageW / monsterImageW (near: /80), fxWorldH = monster.baseH * fxImageH / monsterImageH (near: /60).
anchor: put the FX pivot on the monster's body centre: worldX = sprite centre + (u - 0.5) * baseW, worldY = sprite bottom (floor y) + vFromBottom * baseH. Draw it 0.01 in front of the monster (towards the camera), renderOrder above the monster. bodyCentrePx is the average idle bbox centre, measured from the shipped sprites (alpha > 150).

hintGlow.drawAt: exactly on the hand button rect from layout585.json (Ilsevar hand_main = [137, 447, 31, 31]), after the icon and the recovery overlay. blend normal (source-over).
hintGlow.loop: 1-2-3-4 at 2 fps (2 s per breath). Frames are a smooth breath: 85% -> 95% -> 100% -> 90% brightness of frame 3; max change 15%, never off, so no blinking.
hintGlow.reducedMotion: if prefers-reduced-motion (or a no-flicker option), hold frame 3 still.
hintGlow.showWhen: after the FIRST resisted blade hit (map.resist) in a fight, on the hand slot of Ilsevar that holds 'wand' (else 'scroll'). Only while that hand is ready (not recovering, has mana, Ilsevar not downed); hiding while recovering is fine because his tap ends the hint anyway.
hintGlow.hideWhen: the first time Ilsevar's wand/scroll hand is tapped (save a flag, e.g. hints.frostWand = true, and never show it again), or the fight ends. Torch swap mode (gold .swap-armed) wins: hide the hint while swap mode is armed.
